industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Margun Enerji Uretim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.s.
summary: Margun Enerji Uretim Sanayi ve Ticaret AS engages in electricity generation from renewable energy sources. It also offers solar power generation and provision of project development, EPC services, operating, and maintenance services. The company was founded on November 25, 2014 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
